introduction_text:
Provision Your ERPNext Site

Enter your desired subdomain and set an admin password to provision your own ERPNext site. Your site will be ready within a few minutes.
name: site-provisioning-form
success_message: Your site provisioning request has been submitted! You will receive an email once your site is ready.
